title: How a Godly Man Handles the Urge He Hasn't Told Anyone About
caption:
Every man feels the pull before he decides what to do with it. Feeling it was never the sin. Obeying it is.

Name the urge before it names you. Put one breath between feeling it and feeding it. Say it out loud to a brother before it grows stronger in silence.

Self-control isn't built in the moment that matters most. It's built in the small no nobody's watching.

#faith #selfcontrol #christianmen #discipline #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
